# ClaimSaver+

> Self-help software so you can file a Florida motor-vehicle no-fault (PIP) claim yourself. You prepare the paperwork and send it to your insurer. Flat $499 one time, per filer. Not a law firm. Not legal advice.

People search for: file a PIP claim in Florida, Florida no-fault after a car accident, PIP without a lawyer, lawyer won’t take my PIP claim, 14-day PIP rule, PIP documents checklist.

## Product

- Name: ClaimSaver+ platform access
- Price: $499 USD one time, per filer
- What it is: Guided PIP worksheets, document vault, reminders, and education so you can file your own Florida no-fault claim
- What it is not: A law firm, public adjuster, or anyone who files, negotiates, or speaks to the insurer for you
- Clinic dashboard: separate staff-software subscription; price is discussed in a 15-minute demo
